subject: general
question: Dipika Pallikal and Joshna Chinappa won the doubles title at the World Championships in which sport on 9 April 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Squash__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Dipika Pallikal won the women's doubles and mixed doubles titles with Joshna Chinappa and Saurav Ghosal, respectively at the World Doubles Squash Championships in Glasgow on 9 April 2022.
 
• Dipika Pallikal and Saurav Ghosal defeated England's Adrian Waller and Alison Waters 11-6, 11-8 in the final at the Scotstoun Leisure Centre.
 
• They became India's first-ever World Doubles squash champions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• ​Anahat Singh has become the first Indian girl to win the U-15 girls category of the **Junior US Open Squash tournament in Philadelphia.**
 
• Saurav Ghosal has become the first Indian squash player to win the Malaysian Open Championships in November 2021.
